lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Conductor!

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Can you spare a moment to chat?
Sure, what is it?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I've been trying to venture on a new musical path,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: but I'm having trouble choosing the direction.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I was hoping you could perhaps give me some guidance?
Play music that makes you feel warm inside.
Play music that makes you tear up.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I should go for music that's passionate and rhythmic.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I've always been wary of veering in that direction,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: but if that's where you say I should go...

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I should go for the kind of music that takes you back to simpler times.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I've actually dabbled in that style before,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: but it seems you're saying I should focus all my attention on it...

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: All right, then it's settled! Starting today, that's what I'll do!
So quickly?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: There's no point in wasting time since I've decided which direction to pursue.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Once I accomplish what I've set out to do, I'll give you the performance of a lifetime, Conductor.
I look forward to it.
